# THIRD PARTY NOTICES — preliminary foundation inventory

Not a redistribution clearance. No public installer/release exists. Full graph/license and missing text review remain release gates. Generated by scripts/supply-chain.mjs and augmented after controlled engine promotion.

## external engines: promoted project-local binaries

Classification: `EXTERNAL_ENGINES`. These are independently versioned command-line
programs, not linked libraries. Their manifests and external integrity receipts are
under `tools/engines/` and `tools/receipts/engines/`. Redistribution remains subject
to including the applicable license text/notices in the eventual installer.

## build-tooling: NSIS 3.12

Classification: `BUILD_TOOLING`; not required on the end-user computer.

Source: https://github.com/NSIS-Dev/nsis.git, tag `v312`, commit
`e3f60402bcdf7be822d159b531c6e38ddf32de12`.

The promoted project-local kit contains NSIS core, `nsDialogs`, `System`, four
LZMA stubs, four zlib stubs, and locally built zlib 1.3.2. It contains no bzip2
and no third-party NSIS plugins. Applicable notices are bundled in
`tools/packaging/nsis/3.12/COPYING` and `tools/packaging/nsis/3.12/LICENSES/`:

- NSIS core, `nsDialogs`, and `System`: zlib/libpng license;
- LZMA module: CPL 1.0 with the NSIS special linking exception;
- zlib 1.3.2: zlib License.

SCons 4.11.1 was a verified isolated build dependency and is not redistributed
in the kit. Public EDY VERDICT binaries remain subject to a future Authenticode
release gate.
